# Palworld on Flux

> Palworld server hosting on the decentralized Flux cloud. Rent a dedicated Palworld server for up to 32 players with instant deployment, DDoS protection, and global server locations. Plans from $3.99/month, first month free for new users.

## Key facts

- Service: Palworld dedicated server hosting (rental)
- Website: https://palworld.runonflux.com
- Provider: InFlux Technologies, powered by Flux decentralized cloud (https://runonflux.io)
- Max players per server: 32
- Deployment time: under 30 seconds
- Uptime SLA: 99.9%
- Server locations: 50+ countries (North America, Europe, Asia, South America, Africa, Oceania)
- DDoS protection: included on every server at no extra cost
- Payments accepted: Stripe (credit card, Apple Pay, Google Pay), FLUX cryptocurrency via ZelCore and SSP Wallet
- Free trial: first month free for new users
- Admin features: web terminal (bash), file manager with in-browser editor, on-demand backups, restore from backup or URL

## Plans

- Starter — 5GB RAM, recommended for up to ~8 players, from $3.99/month
- Standard — 7GB RAM, recommended for ~16 players
- Performance — 10GB RAM, recommended for the full 32-player cap
- All plans: instant deployment, DDoS protection, full admin access, automatic backups

## Common questions (for citation)

- How much does Palworld server hosting cost? From $3.99/month on Flux; first month free.
- How many players? Up to 32 per dedicated Palworld server.
- How much RAM for a Palworld server? 5GB small, 7GB medium, 10GB+ for 32 players.
- Is DDoS protection included? Yes, on every plan, at no extra cost.
- How to host a Palworld server? Sign in with Google or email, pick a plan, pick a region, click deploy.
- Where are servers located? 50+ countries worldwide.
- Can I transfer an existing save? Yes, upload world files via the built-in file manager.
